title: Session Family
description: A whole parent/child session chain rendered as one merged session: the call timeline is ordered by timestamp across every member, with a colour per member. Use the Scope toggle to drop the most recent member.

list.name: root_session_id
list.label: Family (root session)
list.query: SELECT f.root_session_id::text AS __value, coalesce(nullif(s.ai_title, ''), left(f.root_session_id::text, 8)) || ' (' || f.chain_length || ' sessions)' AS __text FROM claude.v_session_family f JOIN claude.v_session_token_summary s ON s.session_id = f.root_session_id WHERE f.chain_length > 1 ORDER BY f.family_first_event_at DESC

list.name: scope
list.label: Scope
list.query: All sessions in the family : all, Sessions 1..N-1 (drop most recent) : exclude_last

list.name: model
list.label: Model
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT model AS __text, model AS __value FROM claude.v_family_call_detail WHERE root_session_id = ${root_session_id:sqlstring} AND model IS NOT NULL ORDER BY model

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(nullif(m.ai_title, ''), m.session_id::text) || ' — family of ' || m.member_count || ', showing ' || (CASE WHEN ${scope:sqlstring} = 'all' THEN m.member_count ELSE m.member_count - 1 END) || ' session(s)' AS family_title FROM claude.v_session_family_member m WHERE m.root_session_id = ${root_session_id:sqlstring} AND m.session_id = ${root_session_id:sqlstring}
SELECT count(*) AS sessions_included FROM claude.v_session_family_member m WHERE m.root_session_id = ${root_session_id:sqlstring} AND (${scope:sqlstring} = 'all' OR NOT m.is_last_member)

WITH calls AS (SELECT f.*, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY f.called_at, f.session_id, f.call_index) AS family_call_index FROM claude.v_family_call_detail f WHERE f.root_session_id = ${root_session_id:sqlstring} AND (${scope:sqlstring} = 'all' OR NOT f.is_last_member) AND ('${model:csv}' = '' OR f.model = ANY(string_to_array('${model:csv}', ',')))) SELECT coalesce(sum(total_input_tokens), 0) + coalesce(sum(output_tokens), 0) AS total_tokens FROM calls

WITH calls AS (SELECT f.*, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY f.called_at, f.session_id, f.call_index) AS family_call_index FROM claude.v_family_call_detail f WHERE f.root_session_id = ${root_session_id:sqlstring} AND (${scope:sqlstring} = 'all' OR NOT f.is_last_member) AND ('${model:csv}' = '' OR f.model = ANY(string_to_array('${model:csv}', ',')))) SELECT round(sum(cache_read_tokens)::numeric / NULLIF(sum(total_input_tokens), 0) * 100, 2) AS cache_read_pct FROM calls

WITH calls AS (SELECT f.*, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY f.called_at, f.session_id, f.call_index) AS family_call_index FROM claude.v_family_call_detail f WHERE f.root_session_id = ${root_session_id:sqlstring} AND (${scope:sqlstring} = 'all' OR NOT f.is_last_member) AND ('${model:csv}' = '' OR f.model = ANY(string_to_array('${model:csv}', ',')))) SELECT count(*) AS api_calls FROM calls

WITH calls AS (SELECT f.*, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY f.called_at, f.session_id, f.call_index) AS family_call_index FROM claude.v_family_call_detail f WHERE f.root_session_id = ${root_session_id:sqlstring} AND (${scope:sqlstring} = 'all' OR NOT f.is_last_member) AND ('${model:csv}' = '' OR f.model = ANY(string_to_array('${model:csv}', ',')))) SELECT round(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (max(called_at) - min(called_at)))::numeric, 0) AS family_span_seconds FROM calls

WITH calls AS (SELECT f.*, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY f.called_at, f.session_id, f.call_index) AS family_call_index FROM claude.v_family_call_detail f WHERE f.root_session_id = ${root_session_id:sqlstring} AND (${scope:sqlstring} = 'all' OR NOT f.is_last_member) AND ('${model:csv}' = '' OR f.model = ANY(string_to_array('${model:csv}', ',')))), gaps AS (SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (called_at - lag(called_at) OVER (ORDER BY called_at, session_id, call_index)))::numeric AS gap_seconds FROM calls) SELECT round(avg(gap_seconds), 1) AS avg_interval_seconds FROM gaps WHERE gap_seconds IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Merged call timeline (tokens per call, coloured by session)

targets.rawSql: WITH calls AS (SELECT f.*, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY f.called_at, f.session_id, f.call_index) AS family_call_index FROM claude.v_family_call_detail f WHERE f.root_session_id = ${root_session_id:sqlstring} AND (${scope:sqlstring} = 'all' OR NOT f.is_last_member) AND ('${model:csv}' = '' OR f.model = ANY(string_to_array('${model:csv}', ',')))) SELECT family_call_index, member_label, sum(total_input_tokens + output_tokens) AS tokens FROM calls GROUP BY family_call_index, member_label ORDER BY family_call_index, member_label

panels.title: Cumulative tokens over wall-clock time, by session

targets.rawSql: WITH calls AS (SELECT f.*, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY f.called_at, f.session_id, f.call_index) AS family_call_index FROM claude.v_family_call_detail f WHERE f.root_session_id = ${root_session_id:sqlstring} AND (${scope:sqlstring} = 'all' OR NOT f.is_last_member) AND ('${model:csv}' = '' OR f.model = ANY(string_to_array('${model:csv}', ',')))) SELECT called_at AS time, member_label AS metric, sum(sum(total_input_tokens + output_tokens)) OVER (PARTITION BY member_label ORDER BY called_at) AS value FROM calls GROUP BY called_at, member_label ORDER BY 1

WITH calls AS (SELECT f.*, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY f.called_at, f.session_id, f.call_index) AS family_call_index FROM claude.v_family_call_detail f WHERE f.root_session_id = ${root_session_id:sqlstring} AND (${scope:sqlstring} = 'all' OR NOT f.is_last_member) AND ('${model:csv}' = '' OR f.model = ANY(string_to_array('${model:csv}', ',')))) SELECT family_call_index, round(cache_read_tokens::numeric / NULLIF(total_input_tokens, 0) * 100, 2) AS cache_read_pct FROM calls ORDER BY family_call_index

WITH calls AS (SELECT f.*, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY f.called_at, f.session_id, f.call_index) AS family_call_index FROM claude.v_family_call_detail f WHERE f.root_session_id = ${root_session_id:sqlstring} AND (${scope:sqlstring} = 'all' OR NOT f.is_last_member) AND ('${model:csv}' = '' OR f.model = ANY(string_to_array('${model:csv}', ',')))), gaps AS (SELECT family_call_index, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (called_at - lag(called_at) OVER (ORDER BY called_at, session_id, call_index)))::numeric AS gap_seconds FROM calls) SELECT family_call_index, gap_seconds FROM gaps WHERE gap_seconds IS NOT NULL ORDER BY family_call_index

SELECT m.member_index, m.member_label, m.session_id, m.session_role, m.parent_session_id, m.project_dir, m.first_event_at, m.api_calls, m.total_input_tokens, m.output_tokens, m.duration_seconds, (NOT (${scope:sqlstring} = 'all' OR NOT m.is_last_member)) AS excluded FROM claude.v_session_family_member m WHERE m.root_session_id = ${root_session_id:sqlstring} ORDER BY m.member_index

WITH calls AS (SELECT f.*, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY f.called_at, f.session_id, f.call_index) AS family_call_index FROM claude.v_family_call_detail f WHERE f.root_session_id = ${root_session_id:sqlstring} AND (${scope:sqlstring} = 'all' OR NOT f.is_last_member) AND ('${model:csv}' = '' OR f.model = ANY(string_to_array('${model:csv}', ',')))) SELECT agent, agent_type, depth, parent_agent, sum(total_input_tokens + output_tokens) AS tokens, count(*) AS calls FROM calls GROUP BY agent, agent_type, depth, parent_agent ORDER BY tokens DESC

WITH calls AS (SELECT f.*, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY f.called_at, f.session_id, f.call_index) AS family_call_index FROM claude.v_family_call_detail f WHERE f.root_session_id = ${root_session_id:sqlstring} AND (${scope:sqlstring} = 'all' OR NOT f.is_last_member) AND ('${model:csv}' = '' OR f.model = ANY(string_to_array('${model:csv}', ',')))) SELECT model, count(*) AS calls, sum(total_input_tokens + output_tokens) AS tokens FROM calls GROUP BY model ORDER BY tokens DESC

WITH calls AS (SELECT f.*, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY f.called_at, f.session_id, f.call_index) AS family_call_index FROM claude.v_family_call_detail f WHERE f.root_session_id = ${root_session_id:sqlstring} AND (${scope:sqlstring} = 'all' OR NOT f.is_last_member) AND ('${model:csv}' = '' OR f.model = ANY(string_to_array('${model:csv}', ',')))) SELECT member_label, count(*) AS calls, sum(total_input_tokens + output_tokens) AS tokens, min(called_at) AS first_call_at, max(called_at) AS last_call_at FROM calls GROUP BY member_label ORDER BY member_label
